note: Live controls for internal/store, the SQLite adapter. Most of this package is round-trip: a record written and read back, which AGENTS.md says needs no control. These are the branches a wrong query still answers through. Seeded by qy3de.9; the schema-version refusals added by dw32p.35, when the v6 conversion was deleted and the refusal became the whole of the v6 story.

controls.clause: A tombstone is a state, not an absence: IssuesByID answers for a removed Issue, which is what lets a page mark a removed relation rather than drop it (qy3de.9)
